title: How to learn good representations by prediction?
reading: The slide compares optimal masking ratios across modalities for masked-prediction representation learning: roughly 75% of an image should be masked, while only about 15% of tokens are masked in BERT-style language pretraining. The explanation offered is that image information is far more redundant than linguistic information, so much more can be removed while still leaving a solvable but nontrivial prediction task. The practical takeaway is that the masking ratio is a design choice to be tuned to the application/modality.
